description: Start a long-running Internet.nl deep scan. Internet.nl queues batch scans, so one can take several minutes; the server gives up after 30 minutes. Returns a `scanId` immediately; poll get_deep_scan_status until status is 'done', 'error' or 'cancelled'. Every call starts a new scan, so do not repeat a call that succeeded. Does not modify the domain: it only reads its public DNS, web and mail endpoints. Internet.nl runs an exhaustive standards-compliance audit (IPv6, DNSSEC, modern TLS, RPKI, mail

domain.description: Domain name only, e.g. example.com (no URL, path, or port)

name: intodns__start_deep_scan
